name: traceback
description: TraceBack — AI-assisted Lost & Found Item Tracker (PCE SW PS 13)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.clean: node -e "const{rmSync}=require('fs');for(const p of ['server/node_modules','client/node_modules','client/dist'])rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('cleaned: server/node_modules, client/node_modules, client/dist')"
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup
